settings.title: GravityLAN Settings
settings.reset_warning: Warning: This irreversibly deletes all devices, histories, and scans!

!!! WARNING !!!

Do you really want to permanently delete ALL devices and services?
This cannot be undone!

settings.scan_timeout_desc: Increase this value (e.g., to 2.0) if devices in deep sleep are not detected.
settings.offline_threshold_hint: Consecutive failed checks (ping, ARP and TCP) before a device counts as offline and the offline webhook fires. Prevents flapping of containers and busy switches.
settings.log_level_desc: Note: SQL logs slow down the system and make the logs very cluttered.
settings.system_livelogs_desc: Real-time view of backend processes (troubleshooting & monitoring)

settings.dns_custom_desc: If set, the scanner will use this server to resolve hostnames instead of the system default.
